entities.name: UE capability information transfer
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the network to retrieve UE radio access capability information from a UE in RRC_CONNECTED state.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC state where the UE has an established RRC connection with the network.

entities.name: AS security activation
entities.description: Condition where AS security has been successfully activated between UE and network.

entities.name: UE capabilities retrieved before AS security activation
entities.description: Property indicating UE capabilities that were retrieved prior to AS security activation, which are not forwarded to the core network.

relations.description: The UE capability information transfer procedure requires the UE to be in RRC_CONNECTED state.
The network should retrieve UE capabilities only after AS security activation.
UE capabilities retrieved before AS security activation are not forwarded to the core network.
